headline: Early reference: latest official benchmarks with effective dates. Nigeria parallel-market ranges are withheld pending verified observations. Not live opening quotes.
nigeria_note: CBN selling rates are the latest available benchmarks dated 9 Nov. Nigeria parallel-market ranges are withheld because no sufficiently current, independently corroborated observations could be verified before the early deadline. Aggregated from multiple independent market sources.

Ghana.note: Bank of Ghana interbank mid-rates, 9 Nov (latest dated table); buy/sell and mid rows read directly.

Kenya.note: CBK commercial-banks' average closing rates, posted 9 Nov (market close 6 Nov inferred); not a standalone buy or sell quote.

South Africa.note: SARB weighted-average bank rates, 6 Nov (latest verified; carried forward, SARB endpoint not retrievable this session).

Egypt.note: CBE official buy/sell mid-rates, 8 Nov (latest verified; carried forward, CBE site not retrievable this session).

markets_note: Latest official reference values with effective dates: Ghana mid of Bank of Ghana buy/sell (9 Nov); Kenya CBK commercial-banks’ average closing rates (posted 9 Nov, close 6 Nov inferred; not a standalone buy or sell quote); South Africa SARB weighted-average bank rates (6 Nov, carried forward); Egypt mid of CBE buy/sell (8 Nov, carried forward).
